$comment: Doctrina project configuration — add a key to change it. Options: "language" ("en" | "pt", or null to detect per file); "surface" ("core": AGENTS.md lists the session loop and defers the rest to `doctrina --help`; "full": it lists every command; then `doctrina upgrade --write`); "context_budget" (positive integer, default 15000); "rules" (array of { id, forbid, paths, message } — permanent project constraints enforced by `doctrina validate`). Run `doctrina doctor` to see the effective value of each option and where it came from.
